ValidationRule.description: Validates that the feature version being received is sequential to the current version
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED( OCV_Feature_Version__c), Force_Update__c = false, OR( ISNULL(PRIORVALUE(OCV_Feature_Version__c)), OCV_Feature_Version__c - PRIORVALUE(OCV_Feature_Version__c) > 1 ) )
